info.name: Astha Fatoora API
info.description:
REST API of Astha Fatoora (ZATCA e-invoicing). Base path: /api/v1. JSON in and out; dates are ISO yyyy-MM-dd, timestamps ISO-8601 UTC, money as decimal numbers (SAR).

Auth: POST /auth/login sets an httpOnly JWT cookie (`fatoora_session`). Keep a cookie jar. For every POST/PUT/DELETE send header X-XSRF-TOKEN = value of the XSRF-TOKEN cookie (get it first with GET /auth/csrf; it can rotate, so re-read it from the cookie jar before each write).

Roles: OPERATOR > ADMIN > ACCOUNTANT > VIEWER. Writes need ADMIN or ACCOUNTANT unless marked otherwise.

Errors: {"code", "message", "fields"}. 400 validation (fields = per-field messages), 401 not signed in, 403 role not allowed, 404 not found, 409 conflict, 429 locked.

Lists of invoices, audit log and notifications are Spring pages: {content, totalElements, totalPages, number, size}.
